snippet.title: FriendOS - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST HERE - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3727410/FriendOS/
join the discord! - https://discord.gg/eCjYgnZdzX
FriendOS is a singleplayer/online bullet-hell RPG set within a virus-infected computer. Customize your Friend and team up with others to fish, socialize, and explore the depths of a dying operating system.

hey !!! i've been serving as a composer and sound designer for FriendOS!! if you like my music i highly recommend you check it out, as you'll be hearing plenty there!! (i'll be doing a standalone upload or two for tracks i helped compose soon as well!) 
play the game! it'll have Earl in it! (LIE)

(you can listen to the clean trailer music here! https://soundcloud.com/rolobi/trailer-theme-friendos-ost)
